using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Emby.Server.Implementations;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var pluginManagerMock = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();

            var applicationPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var startupOptionsMock = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            var startupConfigMock = new Mock<IConfiguration>();

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<ApplicationHost>()).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                applicationPathsMock.Object,
                loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                startupOptionsMock.Object,
                startupConfigMock.Object,
                pluginManagerMock.Object,
                serviceProviderMock.Object);

            var testType = typeof(string);
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            // Act
            var result = host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            pluginManagerMock.Verify(p => p.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(format => format.ToString().Contains("Error creating {Type}")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsLoop_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var pluginManagerMock = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();

            var applicationPathsMock = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var startupOptionsMock = new Mock<IStartupOptions>();
            var startupConfigMock = new Mock<IConfiguration>();

            var loggerFactoryMock = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            loggerFactoryMock.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<ApplicationHost>()).Returns(loggerMock.Object);

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(
                applicationPathsMock.Object,
                loggerFactoryMock.Object,
                startupOptionsMock.Object,
                startupConfigMock.Object,
                pluginManagerMock.Object,
                serviceProviderMock.Object);

            var testType = typeof(string);

            // Simulate loop detection
            host.SetCreatingInstances(new List<Type> { testType });

            // Act & Assert
            Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType));
            loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>>(format => format.ToString().Contains("DI Loop detected")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string, object[]>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
            pluginManagerMock.Verify(p => p.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Test double to expose protected method and dependencies
    public class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
    {
        private readonly IPluginManager _pluginManager;
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;
        private List<Type> _creatingInstances;

        public TestApplicationHost(
            IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
            ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            IStartupOptions options,
            IConfiguration startupConfig,
            IPluginManager pluginManager,
            IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
            : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, options, startupConfig)
        {
            _pluginManager = pluginManager;
            ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
        }

        protected override IPluginManager CreatePluginManager(ILogger logger, ApplicationHost host, IServerConfiguration config, string pluginsPath, Version version)
            => _pluginManager;

        public new object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type) => base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);

        public void SetCreatingInstances(List<Type> creatingInstances)
        {
            _creatingInstances = creatingInstances;
        }

        protected override List<Type> CreatingInstances => _creatingInstances ??= new List<Type>();
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using MediaBrowser.Common.Plugins;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Plugins;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostCreateInstanceSafeTests
    {
        private class TestApplicationHost : ApplicationHost
        {
            public List<Type> CreatingInstances { get; set; } = new();
            public IServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; set; }
            public IPluginManager PluginManager { get; set; }

            public TestApplicationHost(
                ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
                IPluginManager pluginManager = null)
                : base(
                    Mock.Of<Emby.Server.Implementations.IServerApplicationPaths>(),
                    loggerFactory,
                    Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.IStartupOptions>(),
                    Mock.Of<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>())
            {
                PluginManager = pluginManager ?? Mock.Of<IPluginManager>();
            }

            protected override List<Type> CreatingInstancesInternal => CreatingInstances;
            public new object CreateInstanceSafe(Type type) => base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ThrowsException_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory().AddProvider(new MockLoggerProvider(logger.Object));
            
            var mockPluginManager = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var testType = typeof(string);
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");

            var mockActivator = new MockActivatorUtilities
            {
                CreateInstanceAction = (_, __) => throw exception
            };

            // Act
            var host = new TestApplicationHost(loggerFactory.Object, mockPluginManager.Object);
            host.ServiceProvider = mockActivator;

            var result = host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            mockPluginManager.Verify(p => p.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Error creating " + testType.Name)),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DetectsLoop_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory().AddProvider(new MockLoggerProvider(logger.Object));
            var mockPluginManager = new Mock<IPluginManager>();
            var testType = typeof(string);

            var host = new TestApplicationHost(loggerFactory.Object, mockPluginManager.Object);
            host.CreatingInstances.Add(testType);

            // Act & Assert
            var exception = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", exception.Message);
            
            logger.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("DI Loop detected")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
            
            mockPluginManager.Verify(p => p.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Simplified mock implementations for test compilation
    public interface IPluginManager
    {
        void FailPlugin(System.Reflection.Assembly assembly);
    }

    public class MockLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> _logger;
        public MockLoggerProvider(Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> logger) => _logger = logger;

        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger.Object;
        public void Dispose() { }
    }

    public class MockActivatorUtilities
    {
        public Action<IServiceProvider, Type> CreateInstanceAction { get; set; } = (_, __) => { };
        public static object CreateInstance(IServiceProvider provider, Type type)
        {
            if (provider is MockActivatorUtilities mock)
            {
                mock.CreateInstanceAction(mock, type);
            }
            return null;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Moq.Language.Flow;

namespace Emby.Server.Implementations.Tests
{
    public class ApplicationHostCreateInstanceSafeTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_ExceptionThrown_LogsErrorWithException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            loggerFactory.AddProvider(new CapturingLoggerProvider(loggerMock));
            
            var pluginManagerMock = new Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager>();
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            
            var mockApplicationPaths = Mock.Of<Emby.Server.Implementations.IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var mockStartupOptions = Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.IStartupOptions>();
            var mockConfig = Mock.Of<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>();

            var host = new MinimalApplicationHost(
                mockApplicationPaths, 
                loggerFactory, 
                mockStartupOptions, 
                mockConfig,
                serviceProviderMock.Object,
                pluginManagerMock.Object);

            var testType = typeof(string);
            Mock.Get(serviceProviderMock.Object)
                .Setup(sp => sp.GetService(It.IsAny<Type>()))
                .Throws(new InvalidOperationException("Test failure"));

            // Act
            var result = host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType);

            // Assert
            Assert.Null(result);
            pluginManagerMock.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
            
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Error creating") && v.ToString()!.Contains(testType.Name)),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void CreateInstanceSafe_DILoopDetected_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>>();
            var loggerFactory = new LoggerFactory();
            loggerFactory.AddProvider(new CapturingLoggerProvider(loggerMock));
            
            var pluginManagerMock = new Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager>();
            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            
            var mockApplicationPaths = Mock.Of<Emby.Server.Implementations.IServerApplicationPaths>();
            var mockStartupOptions = Mock.Of<MediaBrowser.Controller.IStartupOptions>();
            var mockConfig = Mock.Of<Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration>();

            var host = new MinimalApplicationHost(
                mockApplicationPaths, 
                loggerFactory, 
                mockStartupOptions, 
                mockConfig,
                serviceProviderMock.Object,
                pluginManagerMock.Object);

            var testType = typeof(string);
            host._creatingInstances.Add(testType);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = Assert.Throws<TypeLoadException>(() => host.CreateInstanceSafe(testType));
            Assert.Equal("DI Loop detected", ex.Message);
            
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("DI Loop detected")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
            
            pluginManagerMock.Verify(pm => pm.FailPlugin(testType.Assembly), Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Minimal implementation that only implements required abstract members
    public class MinimalApplicationHost : Emby.Server.Implementations.ApplicationHost
    {
        public List<Type> _creatingInstances = new();
        public readonly Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager> PluginManagerMock;

        public MinimalApplicationHost(
            Emby.Server.Implementations.IServerApplicationPaths applicationPaths,
            Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILoggerFactory loggerFactory,
            MediaBrowser.Controller.IStartupOptions options,
            Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration startupConfig,
            Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceProvider serviceProvider,
            Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager pluginManager)
            : base(applicationPaths, loggerFactory, options, startupConfig)
        {
            ServiceProvider = serviceProvider;
            PluginManagerMock = pluginManager as Mock<Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager>;
        }

        protected override System.Collections.Generic.List<System.Type> CreatingInstances => _creatingInstances;

        public new object CreateInstanceSafe(System.Type type) => base.CreateInstanceSafe(type);

        // Minimal implementations of required abstract members
        protected override System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<System.Reflection.Assembly> GetAssembliesWithPartsInternal() => Array.Empty<System.Reflection.Assembly>();
        
        protected override Emby.Server.Implementations.Plugins.IPluginManager CreatePluginManager(
            Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger logger,
            Emby.Server.Implementations.ApplicationHost host,
            MediaBrowser.Controller.Configuration.IServerConfiguration config,
            string pluginsPath,
            System.Version version)
        {
            return PluginManagerMock?.Object ?? throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

    // Helper to capture logger calls
    public class CapturingLoggerProvider : ILoggerProvider
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> _logger;
        public CapturingLoggerProvider(Mock<ILogger<ApplicationHost>> logger) => _logger = logger;
        public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger.Object;
        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}
